outline:
*EMI Course (全英語授課)
This course introduces the fundamentals of storytelling and script planning. By exploring narrative structures and the design thinking process, students will gain hands-on experience in developing an interactive script—from initial planning and analysis to the creation of a finalized visual narrative. Active in-class participation, including brainstorming sessions and discussions, will be evaluated.
For the final group project, students will collaborate to produce a short video based on their original scripts.
